description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number of the results to return. The default value is **1**, which returns the first page of results.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**10**，表示每页包含10条结果。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is **10**.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh:
查询类型。取值：
- **id**:   表示按照规则组ID查询。
- **name**:  表示按照规则组名字查询，支持中英文查询。
description.en:
The query type. Valid values:

- **id**: Queries by rule group ID.

- **name**: Queries by rule group name. Both Chinese and English names are supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-rule-groups --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --search-type name --search-value test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeRuleGroups --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --PageSize 10 --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --PageNumber 1 --SearchValue test --SearchType name --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
